result.summary: Found 3 issues: content overflow causing cards to be partially cut off, and text truncation in restaurant name.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is partially cut off on the right edge of the screen, making the full restaurant name and details not fully visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards are fully visible within the viewport, or implement proper horizontal scrolling with clear affordance indicators

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom of 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off at the bottom of the viewport, with incomplete content visibility
issues.suggestion: Add proper spacing or adjust layout so cards are fully visible, or indicate that scrolling is available to view complete card

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated and incomplete - likely should read 'Trattoria Piccolo'
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant names are fully displayed without text truncation, or implement text truncation with ellipsis (...) if space is limited
